## About
Ross Equipment Repair Inc is a repair shop in San Jose. Customers have brought us company vehicles, work trucks and a motor home with brake trouble.
We hold a 4.3 rating from 35 Google reviews. Give us a call before you come by and we'll talk through what your vehicle needs.

## Services
- Motor home brake problems: One reviewer brought in a motor home with brake problems while traveling and was back on the road soon after.
- Kingpin and bushing work: One customer had the bushing set and kingpin done on a Ford F 650.

## FAQ
Q: What are your hours?
A: Monday through Friday, 7:00 AM to 3:30 PM. We're closed Saturday and Sunday.

Q: Do you work on motor homes?
A: Yes. One reviewer brought in a motor home with brake problems and was told to bring it right in.
